instructions.question: Does this comment show sincere approval (positive), explicit hostility or despair (negative), or neither (neutral)?
instructions.rule: Neutral is the default: questions, discrepancies, forecasts, mild worry, advice or suggestions, complaints about careless citizens without an insult word, tags, off-topic chat, ads, and laughing banter or city-ranking cheering. Negative needs a trigger: a curse, an insult word, blame of the current government, a lying claim (any spelling), ridicule of the Institute, sarcastic praise of worsening results, or a horror or despair word. Positive needs explicit thanks or praise to the Institute, doctors or a person, a blessing, encouragement, or clear joy at falling cases or recoveries; such praise wins even when the rest criticises. A thanks that only prefaces a question is neutral.

neutral.what: The default: questions, doubts, forecasts, worry, advice, complaints without insult, tags, banter, cheering and jokes.
examples: Kta a jon me teste a veq me sy t'testum? (Are these with tests or just tested by eye?)
Mirupafshim ne Shtator e pat puna juv mo keni ra pi liges sikur Hajvalia... (See you in September, you've been relegated like Hajvalia...)
Dedë Valdrin ma gjall ma gjall (Dedë Valdrin, faster, faster)
neutral.cues: tagged names, hahaha, pse (why), duhet (should), karantin (quarantine), maska (masks), per marakli (worth worrying about), liga (league), ma gjall (faster)
neutral.not_for: A curse, insult word, government blame, lying claim, horror word or ridicule of the Institute makes it negative.

positive.what: Explicit thanks or praise to someone (overrides surrounding criticism), blessings, congratulations, encouragement, joy at falling cases or recoveries.
examples: Instituti flm qe na rekomandoni dhe na kshilloni gjdo dite po met vërtet nuk është ka bohet kto dite respketimi i masave (Institute, thanks for advising us daily, but the measures really aren't respected these days)
Hallall ju koft si ju ne kosov qe pi sheroni  pacientet nga Covid 19 (Well done to you in Kosovo for curing patients)
Lakorja paska fillu me ra (The curve has started to fall)
positive.cues: ju lumt (well done), hallall, bravo, respekt (respect), flm/falemnderit (thanks), perhajr (congratulations), te sherum (recovered), ka ra numri (number fell), Zoti na ruajt (God protect us)
positive.not_for: City cheering ('Perpara Prishtina' (Forward Prishtina), 'forza peja'), tags, ads, suggestions ('Postoni mire' (post well)) and 'edhe pak e iku' (almost gone) are neutral.

negative.what: Curses, insults, current-government blame, lying claims, ridicule of the Institute, sarcastic praise, horror or despair.
examples: ona mytet tu na rrejt (they're killing us with lies)
183 a 195 se ju ka hup topi diçka kohëve të fundit (183 or 195, you've lost the plot lately)
Tmerrshem (Horrible)
Mashalla ka hi qeveria e re me kom te mire gjdo dite ma shum raste (Mashallah, the new government came in lucky, more cases daily)
negative.cues: rren/ren/rrejt (lie), fajet (to blame), injorant (ignorant), palaqo/bosa/huti (fool), qifsha (vulgar), tmer (horror), katastrof (catastrophe), ma keq (worse), ZEZA (disaster)
negative.not_for: Laughing banter, or harsh mask complaints without an insult word, is neutral; criticism paired with thanks is positive.
